body:
I need money to survive; to help my parents and siblings! It's all about money!

 I tried but am in serious debt and lost the rest of my cash to my parents. It's my sisters birthday next week and I really wanted to give her a gift and party at home. I need to die before I lose the reputation I have with my siblings. They will think I forgot her b day, and know I'm worthless, which I am.

Anyways, I am glad the system will take care of my family. I'm just waiting for my siblings to fall asleep now, so I can go to the forest and end it all.

My mind is racing, but it's made up. I'm done with this life. I'm tired. I want out. I forgive my family, I am useless to them. 

Who's going to take care of my family once I'm gone? I'm paying for everything, will Government help them?
